headline: Industrial real estate rides FDI wave, profits continue to diverge
summary: FDI inflows into Vietnam are accelerating, boosting demand for industrial park land leases. Q3 2026 profits are forecast to diverge among businesses due to land reserves, handover progress and revenue sources.
why: Industrial parks host foreign manufacturers and are a key channel for foreign direct investment into Vietnam's export economy. Developers' land banks and handover timing drive their earnings.
